description: Email personal invitations for a page to the specified recipient addresses, with an optional message and access expiry. Sends email immediately; sent email cannot be recalled.

expiresInDays.description: Days the links work (default 7). 0 means they never expire.

message.description: Optional note included in the invitation email.

recipients.description: Email addresses; each person gets their own personal link.

siteId.description: Page id (siteId) returned by a publish tool or list_pages.

name: send_page

expiresAt.description: When the links stop working (ms since epoch; year 9999 means never).

title: Send page
